mentions.name: Repair Services Marketplace App
mentions.description: This app is a marketplace for repair services: clients post repair requests for electronics and cars, and repair masters respond with their offers, similar to Action but focused on repairs.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I want to make app like action but for repairs, like electronics and cars.

Client posts request and masters respond with their offers.
